Prophecy: The Scepter Will Not Depart from Judah
ProphecySummary: Jacob blessed Judah as a lion and promised that the scepter would not depart from him until the one to whom it belongs comes. Rulership, in other words, would run through Judah's line to a coming king who would receive the obedience of the nations.
Fulfillment: The promise narrowed through David, of Judah's tribe, and reached its fulfilment in Jesus, the Lion of the tribe of Judah. Revelation presents Him as that promised ruler whose kingdom gathers people from every nation.
RelatedEvents: Davidic Covenant; The Birth of Jesus
